# bunnynet_purge_url (Action)

This action purges a URL from the bunny.net CDN cache. It requires Terraform 1.14 or later.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "bunnynet_purge_url" "homepage" {
  config {
    url = "https://myzone.b-cdn.net/index.html"
  }
}

resource "bunnynet_storage_file" "homepage" {
  zone    = bunnynet_storage_zone.example.id
  path    = "index.html"
  content = "<h1>Hello world</h1>"

  lifecycle {
    action_trigger {
      events  = [after_update]
      actions = [action.bunnynet_purge_url.homepage]
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `url` (String) The URL to purge from the cache. Append a wildcard (`*`) to purge everything under a given path.

### Optional

- `async` (Boolean) Whether the purge should be performed asynchronously: the action returns without waiting for the purge to be executed. Defaults to false.
- `exact_path` (Boolean) Whether only the exact path should be purged, without a wildcard suffix, when the URL ends with a slash. Only applies to pull zones with query string sorting disabled. Defaults to false.
